text:
lily: heads-up — Peregrine wants to expand to 50 seats. procurement is asking for a milestone acceptance schedule instead of simple pilot/convert. they want 3-stage billing (30% at kickoff, 30% at completion of onboarding, 40% at auto-convert). need acceptance path by EOD to lock SE enablement week next week.
marc: interesting, that's different from the usual 50/50 split. any requested discount?
lily: buyer asked for 15% off during the 6mo pilot portion, then list on convert. finance worried about collection risk on multi-stage.
rachel: legal note — primary signer OOO; they asked if procurement can sign a PO with delegated authority. we need either a Delegation of Authority or PO must explicitly name the delegate.
ops-bot: quick check: delegated signer ok if Delegation doc exists or PO includes exact signer name + email. Docusign recommended for speed.
procurement: we'll include a delegated-signer field in the PO template and add vendor code KMS-211. drafting now, ETA 90m.
billing: milestone billing ok, but need billing mechanics in amendment (invoice triggers, net terms, and auto-charge on conversion). recommend card-on-file for the final 40% to reduce fallthrough.
lily: SE slot is Apr 17-21; if we miss EOD we lose that week. buyer prefers milestone split to spread budget.
marc: propose we give Option A: 6mo pilot @ -15% with 30/30/40 milestone billing, Delegation addendum accepted, SE week hold; Option B: immediate annual at list with 100% upfront and guaranteed SE.
rachel: i'll draft a one-page Delegation addendum and a short amendment paragraph clarifying milestone triggers and conversion mechanics.
procurement: PO draft sent to lily@peregrine.io with delegated-signer checkbox + KMS-211 reference.
lily: buyer replied: "Option A preferred, can sign PO but CFO out Thu-Fri. procurement can sign if delegation doc provided. can we accept a scanned PO while final signature follows?"
legal: we can accept a scanned PO with named delegated signer as interim evidence, but require the Delegation addendum executed within 3 business days. include clause: if final signature not received, vendor reserves right to pause conversion.
billing: we'll accept 30% kickoff invoice and 30% at onboarding completion. we'll require card-on-file for the 40% conversion charge or an explicit purchase order that guarantees payment.
marc: i'll update the quote and SOW to reflect milestone dates and include a short conversion billing paragraph and proration rules.
lily: action items captured: 1) send Option A + PO template + Delegation addendum to buyer 2) procurement to get PO scan and route to billing 3) legal to finalize addendum and send for execution 4) billing to prepare milestone invoices and capture card-on-file 5) ops to tentatively hold SE Apr17-21.
procurement: noted. will route completed PO to billing once scanned copy received.
ops-bot: reserved SE resources tentatively for Apr17-21; will reduce scope if final approvals slip.
lily: thanks team — i'll send options to the buyer now and post updates here. will flag if buyer requests wet-sign or bank requires extra steps. :thumbsup:
